scope: Short source-only genuine-asset verification; no archive extraction, spatial render, endpoint or listening

methods.sourceBindings: Existing24-layer manifest SHA/sample/rate verification; PCM memory hashes repeated after all diagnostics.
methods.held: 16moving voices held at normalized source position.7 for2s; Schafter/Bati also compared with unchanged rejected player. Eight idle voices run2.5s.
methods.spectra: 65536-frame Hann spectrum of48kHz output after250ms; resolution.732421875Hz. Report dominant frequency and nearest interval-clock order, not crank RPM. Harmonic distribution uses integrated ±2FFT-bin energy at orders1–64 versus independent raw interval Fourier profile.
methods.seams: 256-frame windows centered on actual phase wraps; compare original native-rate boundary context and untreated original-PCM self-loop joins. Local spectral resolution187.5Hz. These descriptors are not click/listening verdicts.
methods.transitions: 16separate2s slow/rapid source-position sweeps and four3s six-layer accel/lift/decel/run-stop transitions. No benchmark matrix or acoustic solver.

limitations: Unknown native grain/RPM/gain semantics remain unrecovered; interval order is not crankshaft RPM.
A stable repeating clock is necessary but does not certify vehicle recognition, natural mechanical texture or perceptual success.
Pre-start context selection uses a one-sample join comparison; resulting local spectrum and original waveform may differ.
Idle matches a short context and loops a long recording excerpt; it is an explicit approximation.
Raw-reference harmonic comparison measures coloration rather than assuming context smoothing is acoustically neutral.
Phase-based morphing retimes neighboring intervals to the common interpolated interval period. Native PCM samples are unchanged; exact original temporal texture is not universally preserved.
